title: Every fppf covering is refined, etale-locally on the base, by surjective finite locally free maps

standard_prerequisites.use: Chapter lemmas qf-fp-flat-dominates-fppf (reducing fppf covers to locally quasi-finite ones) and etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-at-point (the etale-local finiteness-at-a-point construction); Morphisms-chapter stability lemmas for flat finitely presented base change and the finite-flat-implies-finite-locally-free criterion.

core_obligations: Reduce the covering to locally quasi-finite members.
At each point build the elementary etale neighbourhood with a finite open piece.
Upgrade finiteness plus flatness to finite locally free and cover the base.

proof_roadmap.step: Pointwise etale chart construction plus the finite-locally-free bootstrapping.

difficulty_reason: For an fppf covering {S_i -> S} of schemes over S, the lemma produces an etale covering {S'_a -> S} and surjective finite locally free maps V_a -> S'_a such that the induced fppf covering {V_a -> S} refines {S_i -> S}. The retained proof is written: first use the chapter's qf-fp-flat-dominates-fppf lemma to reduce to the case where every S_i -> S is locally quasi-finite; then for each point s choose an elementary etale neighbourhood (S', s) -> (S, s) and an open V of S_i x_S S' containing a unique point over s' with V -> S' finite (chapter lemma etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-at-point, the Zariski Main Type gadget); V -> S' is then finite locally free since a finite flat finitely presented map with finite fibres is finite locally free (the three cited Morphisms lemmas base-change-finite-presentation, base-change-flat, finite-flat), hence open, and shrinking S' makes it surjective; pointwise variation of s assembles the global refinement. Retained author proof at lines 13619-13646.

dedup.scope: Refinement of fppf covers by finite locally free maps after an etale base covering.
